typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblREODRDataTaggerComments_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SourceCompositeKey as string,
		MaxModifiedDate as timestamp,
		TextTag as string,
		ModifiedUserName as string,
		ListTag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblDataTaggerTags
fromtblDataTaggerTags derive({Copy of MaxModifiedDate} = MaxModifiedDate,
		{Copy of TextTag} = TextTag,
		{Copy of ListTag} = ListTag,
		{Copy of SourceCompositeKey} = SourceCompositeKey,
		{Copy of ModifiedUserName} = ModifiedUserName) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		CommentTimeStamp as string,
		TradeID as string,
		Comments as string,
		Unresolvable as string,
		ModifiedUserName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CommentTimeStamp = MaxModifiedDate,
		TradeID = {Copy of SourceCompositeKey},
		Comments = {Copy of TextTag},
		Unresolvable = ListTag,
		ModifiedUserName),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblREODRDataTaggerComments_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblREODRDataTaggerComments
